problem: Discovery proposal fingerprint pins have only local filesystem race proof; repository-host CREATE_IF_ABSENT_EXCLUSIVE semantics remain unverified.
acceptance: two or more concurrent attempts for one fingerprint yield exactly one durable repository pin
losers receive collision evidence and do not overwrite
source proposals and lineage remain preserved
no queue or authority promotion occurs
title: Repository-host discovery pin race canary
mission: Exercise the canonical coordination/opportunities/proposal-claims/<fingerprint>.json path with concurrent create-if-absent attempts, prove exactly one durable winner plus non-overwriting collision evidence, and leave authority unchanged.

unblock_value.reason: Closes the explicit remaining boundary of the discovery-dedup implementation before repository-host pinning is treated as exercised.

regression_prevention.reason: Detects any mismatch between locally tested wx semantics and the actual GitHub create-if-absent host primitive used by fresh workers.

falsification.claim_to_test: The repository host primitive used by workers preserves create-if-absent exclusivity for one canonical proposal fingerprint.
falsification.disconfirming_evidence: Two distinct concurrent contenders both create durable winner pins for the same exact fingerprint, or a loser overwrites winner bytes.
falsification.test_or_observation: Launch at least two concurrent create_file attempts against one absent fixture path and record winner/collision outcomes plus final bytes.
falsification.pass_condition: Exactly one create succeeds, every other attempt receives collision/already-exists evidence, final bytes equal the winner, and no queue/promotion state changes.
falsification.fail_condition: More than one substantive winner exists or loser bytes replace winner bytes.
falsification.stop_or_boundary_condition: Do not run against a non-fixture live proposal pin unless exact test authority/write scope is granted.
